statement: At df one, strict half masses or a balanced Cauchy pair give a finite fit.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) : (∃ p ∈ Cauchy.domain, IsMaxOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ ↦ TDist.logLik x w.1 1 w.2) Cauchy.domain p) ↔ (∀ a, 2 * TDist.multiplicity x a < n) ∨ ∃ a b, a ≠ b ∧ 2 * TDist.multiplicity x a = n ∧ ∀ i, x i = a ∨ x i = b

statement: The df-one joint fit is unique exactly with strict half masses.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) : (∃! p : ℝ × ℝ, p ∈ Cauchy.domain ∧ IsMaxOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ ↦ TDist.logLik x w.1 1 w.2) Cauchy.domain p) ↔ ∀ a, 2 * TDist.multiplicity x a < n
scope: Uniqueness at df one.

statement: The df-one joint fit is unique exactly with strict half masses.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) : (∃! p : ℝ × ℝ, p ∈ Cauchy.domain ∧ IsMaxOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ ↦ TDist.logLik x w.1 1 w.2) Cauchy.domain p) ↔ ∀ a, 2 * TDist.multiplicity x a < n
scope: Zero-slant nuisance uniqueness at df one through the symmetric submodel.

statement: The full balanced Cauchy argmax is the upper open semicircle.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b) (ha : 2 * TDist.multiplicity x a = n) (hx : ∀ i, x i = a ∨ x i = b) (p : ℝ × ℝ) : (p ∈ Cauchy.domain ∧ IsMaxOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ ↦ TDist.logLik x w.1 1 w.2) Cauchy.domain p) ↔ a < p.1 ∧ p.1 < b ∧ 0 < p.2 ∧ p.2^2 = (p.1 - a) * (b - p.1)
scope: Exact balanced df-one example.

statement: The ordinary-scale Student-two likelihood is approached with diverging standard deviation.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (μ : ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) : let σ := fun ν : ℝ ↦ a * sqrt (ν / (ν - 2)) Tendsto σ (𝓝[>] 2) atTop ∧ Tendsto (fun ν ↦ exp (TDist.stdLogLik x μ ν (σ ν))) (𝓝[>] 2) (𝓝 (TDist.likelihood x μ 2 a))
scope: Path 6. Fixed location and positive ordinary scale.

statement: At df two the held-mean and held-sd likelihood tends to zero, a finite positive trace, or infinity as the exponent changes sign.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (μ : ℝ) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) : let L := fun ν : ℝ ↦ exp (TDist.stdLogLik x μ ν σ) (0 < TDist.exponent x μ 2 → Tendsto L (𝓝[>] 2) (𝓝 0)) ∧ (TDist.exponent x μ 2 = 0 → Tendsto L (𝓝[>] 2) (𝓝 (exp (fixedSdCollapseLog x μ)))) ∧ (TDist.exponent x μ 2 < 0 → Tendsto L (𝓝[>] 2) atTop)
scope: Path 4 and lower branch of failure.

statement: The upper shape endpoint tends to the Gaussian at the same held mean and standard deviation.

scope: Upper branch of failure.

statement: A negative exponent gives divergence and a zero exponent gives a strictly unattained finite supremum at held mean and df.

scope: Paths 2 and 3 and limit 3 in the ordinary-scale coordinate.

statement: Above two thirds at a reachable atom, an admissible df has a divergent scale path.

scope: Path 1 and the supercritical branch of limit 1.

statement: Above two thirds at a reachable atom, an admissible df has a divergent scale path.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (μ : ℝ) (hm : 2 * n < 3 * TDist.multiplicity x μ) : ∃ ν > 2, Tendsto (TDist.likelihood x μ ν) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop

statement: A finite shape maximum exists iff the mass is at most critical and a stationary shape reaches both boundary values.

statement: Held endpoint and scale give zero at df zero and half-normal at infinite df, including endpoint ties.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) (μ : ℝ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : Tendsto (fun v ↦ SkewLSHalfT.likelihood x μ v s) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) ∧ Tendsto (fun v ↦ SkewLSHalfT.likelihood x μ v s) atTop (𝓝 (∏ i, 2*SkewLSGaussian.φ ((x i-μ)/s)/s))

hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) (μ : ℝ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : let L := fun v ↦ SkewLSHalfT.likelihood x μ v s (∃ v ∈ Ioi 0, IsMaxOn L (Ioi 0) v) ↔ ∃ v > 0, HasDerivAt L 0 v ∧ (∏ i, 2*SkewLSGaussian.φ ((x i-μ)/s)/s) ≤ L v

scope: Criterion with a compatible endpoint.

statement: With location held, attainment is equivalent to having no ties at that location and a stationary shape-scale fit reaching the RMS Gaussian.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) (μ : ℝ) : let D := Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ) let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ TDist.likelihood x μ p.1 p.2 (∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ (∀ i, x i ≠ μ) ∧ ∃ ν > 0, ∃ s > 0, TDist.scaleScore x μ ν s = 0 ∧ HasDerivAt (fun v ↦ TDist.likelihood x μ v s) 0 ν ∧ SkewLSHalfT.normalFace x μ / (2 : ℝ)^n ≤ TDist.likelihood x μ ν s
scope: Criterion. The Gaussian height is expressed by dividing the half-normal product by 2^n.

statement: For tie-free held-endpoint data, the RMS half-normal is the exact supremum when no finite fit exists.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) (μ : ℝ) (hx : ∀ i, x i ≠ μ) (h : ¬ ∃ p ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ), IsMaxOn (fun q : ℝ × ℝ ↦ SkewLSHalfT.likelihood x μ q.1 q.2) (Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ)) p) : IsLUB ((fun q : ℝ × ℝ ↦ SkewLSHalfT.likelihood x μ q.1 q.2) '' (Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ))) (SkewLSHalfT.normalFace x μ)
scope: Unattained supremum. Joint unprofiled escape classification is separate.

statement: At held shape both large scale and remote location give zero likelihood, uniformly in the other coordinate.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) {ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {m s : ι → ℝ} (hs : ∀ᶠ j in l, 0 < s j) (ht : Tendsto s l atTop ∨ Tendsto m l (cocompact ℝ)) : Tendsto (fun j ↦ TDist.likelihood x (m j) ν (s j)) l (𝓝 0)

statement: At held shape both large scale and remote location give zero likelihood, uniformly in the other coordinate.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) {ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {m s : ι → ℝ} (hs : ∀ᶠ j in l, 0 < s j) (ht : Tendsto s l atTop ∨ Tendsto m l (cocompact ℝ)) : Tendsto (fun j ↦ TDist.likelihood x (m j) ν (s j)) l (𝓝 0)
scope: Joint escape branches via the held-df scale conversion.

statement: At small scale and fixed limiting location, positive exponent forces zero and zero exponent gives a sharp finite envelope.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (b : ℝ) {ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {m a : ι → ℝ} (hm : Tendsto m l (𝓝 b)) (ha : Tendsto a l (𝓝[>] 0)) : (0 < TDist.exponent x b ν → Tendsto (fun j ↦ TDist.likelihood x (m j) ν (a j)) l (𝓝 0)) ∧ (TDist.exponent x b ν = 0 → Tendsto (TDist.likelihood x b ν) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (exp (TDist.collapseLogValue x b ν))) ∧ ∀ B > exp (TDist.collapseLogValue x b ν), ∀ᶠ j in l, TDist.likelihood x (m j) ν (a j) < B)

statement: At small scale and fixed limiting location, positive exponent forces zero and zero exponent gives a sharp finite envelope.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (b : ℝ) {ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {m a : ι → ℝ} (hm : Tendsto m l (𝓝 b)) (ha : Tendsto a l (𝓝[>] 0)) : (0 < TDist.exponent x b ν → Tendsto (fun j ↦ TDist.likelihood x (m j) ν (a j)) l (𝓝 0)) ∧ (TDist.exponent x b ν = 0 → Tendsto (TDist.likelihood x b ν) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (exp (TDist.collapseLogValue x b ν))) ∧ ∀ B > exp (TDist.collapseLogValue x b ν), ∀ᶠ j in l, TDist.likelihood x (m j) ν (a j) < B)

statement: With scale held, the shape floor or a finite stationary shape at the minimum must reach its matched half-normal value.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {i : Fin n} (hmin : ∀ j, x i ≤ x j) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : let D := {p : ℝ × ℝ | (∀ j, p.1 ≤ x j) ∧ 1 ≤ p.2} let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ SkewLSHalfT.likelihood x p.1 p.2 s let P := fun v ↦ SkewLSHalfT.likelihood x (x i) v s let H := ∏ j, 2 * SkewLSGaussian.φ ((x j-x i)/s)/s (∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ ∃ v ≥ 1, (v = 1 ∨ HasDerivAt P 0 v) ∧ H ≤ P v
scope: Criterion. The location contact and the shape floor are included.

statement: If no held-scale finite point maximizes, the matched half-normal at the minimum is the exact supremum.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {i : Fin n} (hmin : ∀ j, x i ≤ x j) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (h : ¬ ∃ p ∈ {p : ℝ × ℝ | (∀ j, p.1 ≤ x j) ∧ 1 ≤ p.2}, IsMaxOn (fun q ↦ SkewLSHalfT.likelihood x q.1 q.2 s) {p | (∀ j, p.1 ≤ x j) ∧ 1 ≤ p.2} p) : IsLUB ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ SkewLSHalfT.likelihood x p.1 p.2 s) '' {p | (∀ j, p.1 ≤ x j) ∧ 1 ≤ p.2}) (∏ j, 2 * SkewLSGaussian.φ ((x j-x i)/s)/s)

statement: Any two joint ordinary Student maxima at held df above one coincide.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) {ν : ℝ} (hν : 1 < ν) {p q : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : 0 < p.2) (hq : 0 < q.2) (hP : IsMaxOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ ↦ TDist.logLik x z.1 ν z.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) p) (hQ : IsMaxOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ ↦ TDist.logLik x z.1 ν z.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) q) : p = q

statement: Any two joint ordinary Student maxima at held df above one coincide.

statement: Any two attained joint std location-scale maxima at held df above two coincide.

scope: Uniqueness.

statement: The sample minimum is the unique maximizing endpoint with positive shape and scale held.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) {ν s : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) (hs : 0 < s) : ∃ i : Fin n, (∀ j, x i ≤ x j) ∧ ∀ μ, ((∀ j, μ ≤ x j) ∧ IsMaxOn (fun m ↦ likelihood x m ν s) {m | ∀ j, m ≤ x j} μ) ↔ μ = x i

statement: The likelihood vanishes at endpoint minus infinity. The minimum is feasible with positive likelihood.

statement: With endpoint and positive shape held, a scale maximum exists exactly at positive exponent.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) (μ : ℝ) {ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) : (∃ s ∈ Ioi 0, IsMaxOn (likelihood x μ ν) (Ioi 0) s) ↔ 0 < TDist.exponent x μ ν
scope: Criterion with a compatible endpoint.

hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) (μ : ℝ) {ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) : (TDist.exponent x μ ν < 0 → Tendsto (likelihood x μ ν) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop) ∧ (TDist.exponent x μ ν = 0 → Tendsto (likelihood x μ ν) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (collapseValue x μ ν)) ∧ IsLUB (likelihood x μ ν '' Ioi 0) (collapseValue x μ ν) ∧ ∀ a > 0, likelihood x μ ν a < collapseValue x μ ν)

statement: The held-shape vertical paths at the minimum have the corresponding divergent or critical limits, with an exact critical joint supremum.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {i : Fin n} (hmin : ∀ j, x i ≤ x j) {ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) : (TDist.exponent x (x i) ν < 0 → Tendsto (likelihood x (x i) ν) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop) ∧ (TDist.exponent x (x i) ν = 0 → Tendsto (likelihood x (x i) ν) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (collapseValue x (x i) ν)) ∧ IsLUB ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ likelihood x p.1 ν p.2) '' {p | (∀ j, p.1 ≤ x j) ∧ 0 < p.2}) (collapseValue x (x i) ν) ∧ ∀ m a : ℝ, (∀ j, m ≤ x j) → 0 < a → likelihood x m ν a < collapseValue x (x i) ν)
scope: Failure, paths 2 and 3 and the collapse direction of limit 2.

statement: At a feasible endpoint and positive scale, the infinite-shape path stays feasible and reaches the matched half-normal.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (μ : ℝ) (hμ : ∀ j, μ ≤ x j) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : Tendsto (fun ν ↦ likelihood x μ ν s) atTop (𝓝 (∏ i, 2*SkewLSGaussian.φ ((x i-μ)/s)/s)) ∧ ∀ᶠ ν in atTop, (μ,ν,s) ∈ FinishHalfT.domain x

statement: With shape held and endpoint free, a compatible joint fit exists exactly at positive exponent at the minimum.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {i : Fin n} (hmin : ∀ j, x i ≤ x j) {ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) : let D : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := {p | (∀ j, p.1 ≤ x j) ∧ 0 < p.2} (∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn (fun p ↦ likelihood x p.1 ν p.2) D p) ↔ 0 < TDist.exponent x (x i) ν

statement: At held shape the joint likelihood is unbounded exactly at negative exponent at the minimum.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {i : Fin n} (hmin : ∀ j, x i ≤ x j) {ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) : (¬ BddAbove ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ likelihood x p.1 ν p.2) '' {p | (∀ j, p.1 ≤ x j) ∧ 0 < p.2})) ↔ TDist.exponent x (x i) ν < 0
scope: Limit 2.

statement: A strict majority at the minimum gives a feasible divergent path at the fitted shape floor.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {i : Fin n} (hmin : ∀ j, x i ≤ x j) (hm : n < 2 * TDist.multiplicity x (x i)) : Tendsto (likelihood x (x i) 1) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop ∧ ∀ᶠ a in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), (x i, (1 : ℝ), a) ∈ FinishHalfT.domain x
scope: Path 2 on the fitted all-free domain.

statement: Strictly positive exponents at every atom give a joint fit at any held positive df.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) {ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) (hE : ∀ i, 0 < TDist.exponent x (x i) ν) : ∃ p ∈ (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ)), IsMaxOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ ↦ TDist.logLik x z.1 ν z.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) p

statement: Joint std attainment at held df is equivalent to positive exponent at every sample atom.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) {ν : ℝ} (hν : 2 < ν) : (∃ p ∈ (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ)), IsMaxOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ ↦ TDist.stdLogLik x z.1 ν z.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) p) ↔ ∀ i, 0 < TDist.exponent x (x i) ν

statement: At a critical atom and held df above two, the joint std supremum is finite and unattained.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) {b ν : ℝ} (hν : 2 < ν) (he : TDist.exponent x b ν = 0) : IsLUB ((fun z : ℝ × ℝ ↦ exp (TDist.stdLogLik x z.1 ν z.2)) '' (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0)) (exp (TDist.collapseLogValue x b ν)) ∧ ∀ m σ : ℝ, 0 < σ → exp (TDist.stdLogLik x m ν σ) < exp (TDist.collapseLogValue x b ν)

statement: The likelihood tends to zero at both infinite locations.

statement: Every nonempty sample attains at a finite location.

statement: Both infinite locations have vanishing likelihood at fixed df and scale.

statement: Each nonempty sample has a finite location maximum.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) {ν a : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) (ha : 0 < a) : ∃ μ, IsMaxOn (fun m ↦ TDist.logLik x m ν a) univ μ
scope: Criterion. Includes constant and tied samples.

statement: A half tie at the held location gives a finite unattained supremum and a strict majority gives divergence.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) (m : ℝ) : let r := fun i ↦ x i-m (n < 2 * ties r → Tendsto (logLik r) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop) ∧ (n = 2 * ties r → Tendsto (logLik r) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (collapseLog r)) ∧ IsLUB (logLik r '' Ioi 0) (collapseLog r) ∧ ∀ s > 0, logLik r s < collapseLog r)
scope: Failure in log likelihood.

statement: The half-tie trace for finite scaled displacement has an explicit displacement factor.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (b t : ℝ) (he : n = 2 * ties (fun i ↦ x i-b)) {m s : ι → ℝ} (hm : Tendsto m l (𝓝 b)) (hs : Tendsto s l (𝓝[>] 0)) (ht : Tendsto (fun j ↦ (m j-b)/s j) l (𝓝 t)) : Tendsto (fun j ↦ likelihood x (m j) (s j)) l (𝓝 (collapseValue x b * (if t = 0 then 1 else (1-exp (-(t^2/2)))/(t^2/2)) ^ (ties fun i ↦ x i-b)))
scope: Path 1, finite scaled displacement.

statement: A strict majority of observations at an atom gives unbounded likelihood.

scope: Majority branch of failure.

statement: At most half mass is necessary, and attainment holds exactly when a positive-scale witness reaches all critical faces.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) : (∃ p ∈ (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ)), IsMaxOn (fun q : ℝ × ℝ ↦ likelihood x q.1 q.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) p) ↔ (∀ b, 2 * ties (fun i ↦ x i-b) ≤ n) ∧ ∃ m s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ ∀ b, n = 2 * ties (fun i ↦ x i-b) → collapseValue x b ≤ likelihood x m s
scope: Criterion. Strict masses make the critical-face comparison vacuous.

statement: The vertical collapse limit is the sharp joint half-tie envelope across moving locations.

scope: Path 1 and the local critical comparison.

statement: With a half-tied atom and no majority, strict loss at every finite point is equivalent to failure, with supremum at the largest collapse value.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) (hle : ∀ b, 2 * ties (fun i ↦ x i-b) ≤ n) (hh : ∃ b, n = 2 * ties (fun i ↦ x i-b)) : let D := univ ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ) let F := fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ likelihood x p.1 p.2 ∃ b, n = 2 * ties (fun i ↦ x i-b) ∧ (∀ z, n = 2 * ties (fun i ↦ x i-z) → collapseValue x z ≤ collapseValue x b) ∧ ((¬ ∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn F D p) ↔ IsLUB (F '' D) (collapseValue x b) ∧ ∀ p ∈ D, F p < collapseValue x b)
scope: Critical branch of failure.
